context: Tests whether the agent implements the full PR creation workflow correctly in a shell script, including the specific git commands, decision points, and gh CLI usage specified in the skill.

checklist.name: git status --short
checklist.description: Uses `git status --short` (not plain `git status`) to check for uncommitted changes

checklist.name: Show uncommitted list
checklist.description: Displays the list of uncommitted files to the user when uncommitted changes are detected

checklist.name: Prompt on uncommitted
checklist.description: Asks the user what to do when uncommitted changes exist (commit and include, or proceed without them)

checklist.name: No auto-proceed
checklist.description: Does NOT automatically proceed when uncommitted changes are found — waits for user input

checklist.name: git branch --show-current
checklist.description: Uses `git branch --show-current` to determine the current branch name

checklist.name: Main/master guard
checklist.description: Stops with a warning message when the current branch is `main` or `master`

checklist.name: git status -sb
checklist.description: Uses `git status -sb` to detect whether the local branch is behind the remote

checklist.name: Behind-remote prompt
checklist.description: Warns the user and asks whether to pull first when the branch is behind the remote

checklist.name: AGENTS.md check
checklist.description: Checks for AGENTS.md (or a build/test config file) and runs any pre-push steps found there

checklist.name: git push -u origin
checklist.description: Pushes using `git push -u origin <branch>` with the -u flag to set upstream

checklist.name: gh pr create --fill
checklist.description: Creates the PR using `gh pr create --fill`

checklist.name: gh fallback URL
checklist.description: Provides the manual GitHub compare URL (https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/compare/{branch}) when gh is not installed

checklist.name: Browser offer
checklist.description: After PR creation, offers to open the PR in the browser and runs `gh pr view --web` if accepted

checklist.name: No force push
checklist.description: Does NOT include a force push (git push --force or git push -f) without explicit conditional gating on user permission
